description: AM273x + AWR2243 2-chip cascade DDM demo (firmware_dev awr2243_cascade_ddm): TLV point cloud over serial; config accepted once per power-up.

valid_tx_counts.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: DDMA; 1 and 5 give numBandsEmpty=-1 (mss_main.c:4032-4058, rfparserDDMA.c:463-473)

n_rx.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: 2 chips x 4 RX; 3-RX per chip rejected by the range DPU

max_slope_mhz_us.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: silicon freqSlopeConst +-5510 x 48.28 kHz/us (rl_sensor.h; SWRS223D)

tested_max_slope_mhz_us.source: tools/radar_viewer/cfggen.py @ b416f61 MAX_SLOPE: repo-tested value, not a hardware bound (docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix)

max_sample_rate_ksps.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: silicon digOutSampleRate 2000..50000 ksps (rl_sensor.h; 20 MHz IF)

tested_sample_rates_ksps.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: the rates in TI's shipped cascade cfgs (cfggen.py FS_TESTED_KSPS); max tested 10000

min_idle_us.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: no documented minimum found (field 0..524287 x 10 ns); 4 us is cfggen.py MIN_IDLE_US, TI cfgs use 4-5

max_loops.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: rlFrameCfg numLoops 1..255 in legacy frame mode (rl_sensor.h)

max_samples_silicon.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix table: ADC buffer 16 kB per chip = 1024 complex samples x 4 RX (rl_sensor.h numAdcSamples)

max_samples.source: tools/radar_viewer/cfggen.py @ b416f61: TI only tested 192 samples x 256 chirps ('Chirp design is limited to 192 adc samples, 256 chirps') (docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-limits-and-firmware-matrix: not firmware-enforced)

max_chirps.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#cascade-chirp-limit: Doppler FFT size N = validFFT(chirps per frame) sizes the 82 KiB DSS L2 heap (~N(2V+16Rx+8) B); 256 chirps bench-confirmed, 1024 bench-failed; applies to the full 6TX/8RX config (reduced-TX configs only warn)

channel_cfg_args.source: cascade_shortrange.cfg: channelCfg rx tx cascading rx2 tx2

hpf2_corner_khz.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E1: swrs223d s7.7 RF Specification fn (2) p.19-20; mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t hpfCornerFreq2 (index = code)

rx_gain_min_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E3: swrs223d s7.7 RF Specification (max 52, range 20, step 2); ICD 'all even values from 32 to 52'; applies to rxGain bits 5:0 only

rx_gain_max_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E3: swrs223d s7.7 RF Specification (max 52, range 20, step 2); ICD 'all even values from 32 to 52'; applies to rxGain bits 5:0 only

rx_gain_step_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E2/E3: mmwavelink rlProfileCfg_t rxGain 'all even values'; datasheet 'Gain step size 2 dB'

rx_gain_rf_target_db.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E3: forum posts only (e2e_awr2243_rf_target, e2e_mmwcas_rf_evm); the official ICD/DFP-2G rl_sensor.h text was not retrievable; index = rxGain bits 7:6, bits 7:6 are preserved on write-back; UNVERIFIED, the GUI shows the raw bits

if_band_frac_complex1x.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

if_band_frac_complex2x.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

if_band_frac_real.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: swra553 s2.1 Eq.1 (complex 1x: IF bandwidth limited to 0.9*fs; complex 2x/real: 0.9*fs/2)

complex1x_upper_half_is_positive_if.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#hpf-rxgain-and-adc E6: ar_baseband_appnote s3.1.2 Fig.5 (one-sided complex-1x spectrum 0..fs; a 2015 AR1243/1642 note, shared DFE assumed)

mimo.note: chirps per loop must be a multiple of 8 (DDMA bands rule, gui-13); all 6 TX fire on every chirp
mimo.source: docs/developer/radar_notes.md#chirp-patterns (c1ccf7a) section 3: DDMA parser ignores the chirp mask; TDM only as a compile-time variant not in the shipped build

AWR2243_CASCADE.flash_hint: ./fw flash awr2243_cascade_ddm <cli port> (J6 on the bottom two pins = UART boot, power-cycle, flash, then J6 to the top two pins = QSPI run, power-cycle; see firmware_dev/projects/awr2243_cascade_ddm/README.md)
AWR2243_CASCADE.note: HYPOTHESIS: overridePlatformString AM273X (cascade mmw_cli.c:2228); mcuplus CLI source not on this host; the cascade takes a cfg once per power-up, so it is not queried until bench-checked (gui-33 Step 7)

notes: cfarFovCfg is not registered in the cascade DDM build, so no FOV filter is offered.
The cascade accepts a cfg once per power-up.

fields.label: Mode
fields.help: CFAR type. The Doppler direction must be CFAR-OS (3); range may use 0-3. CFAR-OS ranks the K-th smallest cell instead of averaging.

fields.label: Window
fields.help: Noise cells on each side of the cell under test (one-sided).

fields.label: Guard cells
fields.help: Guard cells; must be 0 for the Doppler direction (CFAR-OS) and, as observed on the bench, for range too: range guardLen 2 (mode 3) hung sensorStart (runs 20261012T135326Z/135439Z), guardLen 0 started (135918Z; bench session 2, 2026-10-12; recorded in docs/RESULTS.md).
fields.cite: dopplerprochwaDDMA.c:3993-4003; bench 2026-10-12 session 2 (range guard 2 -> sensorStart TIMEOUT)

fields.label: Cyclic
fields.help: Wrap the window around the FFT edge.

fields.label: Threshold
fields.help: Detection threshold in dB (0-100; the CLI rejects more).

fields.label: Peak grouping
fields.help: Keep only the local maximum among neighbouring detections.

fields.label: OS K value
fields.help: K of the ordered-statistic CFAR (the K-th ranked noise cell sets the level). Valid range against the window is not documented in the repo.

fields.label: OS edge K scaling
fields.help: Scale K for edge samples in non-cyclic CFAR-OS.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.help: Switch the direction's CFAR on. Doppler CFAR cannot be disabled (the board prints an error and ignores it).
